svg.title: Order only the extra mulch layer
svg.desc: A schematic bed has fifty millimeters of retained existing mulch and a twenty-five millimeter new layer, reaching an illustrative total depth of seventy-five millimeters. Only the new layer belongs in the top-up order.

g.text: Target 75 mm − retained 50 mm = add 25 mm
Depths are illustrative, not planting advice.
